name: Kyoto Tea Ceremony Experience
description: A traditional Japanese tea ceremony led by a certified tea master, in a quiet historic tearoom.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove Walk
description: A peaceful walking path through towering bamboo stalks on the outskirts of Kyoto.

name: Fushimi Inari Shrine Hike
description: A scenic hike through thousands of vermillion torii gates up Mount Inari.

name: Gion District Evening Walk
description: A self-guided evening stroll through Kyoto's historic geisha district, lined with traditional wooden buildings.

name: Nijo Castle Grounds Tour
description: A guided tour of a 17th-century shogun's castle, famous for its 'nightingale floors' that chirp underfoot.
